baseline_models.focus_anchor: The word-2 favor noun, word-3 dual possessive lord-title, and word-4 dual denial verb.
baseline_models.mechanism: Bestowal is joined to sovereign, stagewise care, and the dual verb requires both addressees to answer whether they will attribute that care to falsehood.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply the object placed under acknowledgment or denial.
Lordship, ownership, and authority identify the giver whose acts are being judged.
Repair and nurture make the favor an ongoing formation rather than a detached good.
Attributing falsehood to a thing supplies the explicit act challenged by the question.

changed_reading.before: A generic rhetorical question about blessings.
changed_reading.after: A joint cross-examination: which acts of sovereign, formative care will the two addressees declare false?

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The favor noun and denial verb are read through their shortfall and fulfillment branches while remaining governed by the lord-title.
baseline_models.mechanism: Favors impose a practical charge: denial can occur when recipients fall short of carrying the gift through, so truth is tested in performed response as well as speech.

activation_trace.role: Falling short or withholding effort supplies the recipient-side failure in the mechanism.
Stagewise completion makes the Lord's gift a process that seeks completion in the recipient.
A charge proving true or false by being carried through turns denial into failed enactment.

changed_reading.before: To deny is to state that a favor is untrue.
changed_reading.after: To deny can also be to make a received favor prove false by failing to carry its demand through.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The word-2 split mapping activates following and answering voices, while the dual denial verb still anchors the reading in the question.
baseline_models.mechanism: A non-dominant mapped branch makes the line sound like an antiphonal turn: a voiced gift is followed by the two recipients' answering voice, and refusal is itself an answer.

activation_trace.role: Following in sequence supplies the call-after-gift placement of the question.
A voice following another supplies an antiphonal response mechanism.
Declaring false gives the responding voice its possible negative content.

changed_reading.before: The line asks for private assent to a proposition.
changed_reading.after: The line stages a public answering turn in which two voices must follow the voiced gift.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The word-2 root's capacity branch is held together with the lord-title's nurture branch and the word-4 no-delay branch.
baseline_models.mechanism: A favor may be an ability cultivated by the Lord; the interrogative then presses whether the recipients will deny that capacity by leaving it unused or delaying its exercise.

activation_trace.role: Ability and capacity expand the favor noun from external goods to enabled action.
Nurture supplies the cultivation by which a capacity becomes usable.
Not delaying to act supplies urgency to the recipients' use of what was enabled.

changed_reading.before: The favors are objects outside the addressees.
changed_reading.after: The favors also include cultivated powers inside the addressees, whose nonuse can become denial.

context_deltas.mechanism: Mercy opens into teaching, measured creation, and disclosed meaning; this gives the focus lord-title's nurture branch a womb-to-articulation arc and makes the favor the recipient's own formed answer-capacity.

activation_trace.role: Repair, nurture, and completion anchor the context sequence back in the focus lord-title.
Bestowal keeps the formed capacities within the focus category of favor.
Tender mercy supplies the initiating relation rather than a merely technical act of making.
The womb image supplies an enclosing material analogy for formative care.
Knowledge becoming disclosed supplies the transition from formation to awareness.
Measured formation supplies ordered embodiment rather than undirected production.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign supplies the capacity to formulate an answer.

structural_cues: 55:1-4 moves from mercy through teaching and creation to articulation before the first refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies tender and womb-like mercy, disclosed knowledge, measured creation, and explanatory sign; I infer a causal arc in which lordly care builds the creature's answer-capacity. A live alternative is a list of independent gifts.

changed_reading.before: The Lord gives favors that can later be acknowledged or denied.
changed_reading.after: The Lord forms the very creature and faculties by which acknowledgment becomes possible, so denial turns a received faculty against its source.

context_deltas.mechanism: The balance sequence and the later equivalence of good action with good return convert the gift-list into an account: denying favor is a short measure in reciprocal conduct, and truth is whether the charge is fulfilled.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed favors supply what enters the relational account.
A charge fulfilled or failed supplies the performance test applied to return.
A balance of justice supplies the governing norm for evaluating response.
Justice and equity specify the quality of a truthful return.
Shortchanging measure supplies the concrete model for under-answering favor.
Answering an act with its recompense supplies the reciprocal arrow.
Good action supplies both the received act and the fitting returned act.

structural_cues: 55:7-9 establishes measure and forbids short measure; 55:60 later states an act-for-act reciprocity before the refrain continues.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies just measure, forbidden shortchanging, recompense, and good action; I infer that gifts generate a proportionate responsive obligation. A live alternative is that the balance and recompense passages are parallel themes without an accounting arrow into the refrain.

changed_reading.before: Denial is an incorrect judgment about a gift.
changed_reading.after: Denial is also an inequitable return that gives less acknowledgment and good action than received care calls for.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge to penetrate the cosmic limits distinguishes bestowed capacity from self-grounded power: ability is real but bounded, and passage requires an authorizing force.

activation_trace.role: Capacity keeps the changed reading anchored in the focus favor noun.
Authority locates the source and boundary of enabled action.
Ability and endurance make capacity an explicit contextual test.
Passing cleanly to the other side supplies the concrete task capacity attempts.
Power and delegated authority supply the necessary enabling condition.

structural_cues: 55:33 repeats the penetration verb around a conditional ability clause and an exception for authority.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ability, attempted passage, and required authority; I infer that capacity itself is a lordly favor whose limit discloses dependence. A live alternative is a purely prohibitive challenge about escape.

changed_reading.before: Favors are possessions whose existence might be denied.
changed_reading.after: Capacity itself is a favor, and denying it includes claiming it as autonomous or refusing the dependence revealed at its limit.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two expanses meet without transgressive collapse, and valuables emerge from them; favor is therefore not only a substance but a maintained distinction whose contact becomes productive.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal anchors the productive relation as one kind of focus favor.
Declaring false supplies the possible refusal to recognize relational order.
Mixture and disturbance supply contact that could erase distinction but does not.
Vast abundant water supplies the two material fields brought into relation.
Two things arriving face-to-face supplies genuine meeting rather than isolation.
The middle interval supplies an active boundary between the meeting sides.
Transgressive overreach names the collapse the boundary prevents.
Bringing something out of concealment supplies the relation's emergent yield.
Emergent brilliance supplies the visible value generated from the two waters.

structural_cues: 55:19-22 orders meeting, boundary, non-transgression, and emergence before returning to the refrain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies meeting waters, a middle barrier, restrained transgression, and emergent valuables; I infer that maintained difference enables yield. A live alternative is that the sequence merely catalogs separate physical signs.

changed_reading.before: A favor is a discrete beneficial object.
changed_reading.after: A favor can be a boundary-governed relation that lets distinct things meet and yield value without consuming each other.

context_deltas.mechanism: Perishing creatures, an abiding face, and a new affair across each temporal interval activate the non-dominant remainder branch in the focus: favors become successive traces of enduring care rather than durable possessions.

activation_trace.role: A remainder following what came before supplies the trace-like persistence of each favor.
Staying and lasting anchor persistence in the focus lord-title.
Cessation after a period of remaining supplies the perishability of received forms.
Continuance supplies the contrasting persistence of the giver.
Face standing for the self identifies what remains beyond transient forms.
A bounded duration supplies the cadence in which care appears anew.
An affair or active condition supplies ongoing particular action.

structural_cues: 55:26-29 places universal perishing, abiding presence, universal asking, and recurrent action in immediate sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies cessation, continuance, enduring self-presence, temporal intervals, and active affairs; I infer that transient gifts are recurring traces of an abiding source. A live alternative is a strict creator-creature contrast without a trace mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The question points to stable possessions called favors.
changed_reading.after: The question points through perishing forms to recurring traces of care; denying them mistakes a temporary carrier for either nothing or the abiding source itself.

context_deltas.mechanism: Recognition by visible marks and consequent seizure activate the denial root's deceptive-surface branch: a performed false identity can persist only until its signs become legible.

activation_trace.role: A patterned surface that deceives by its condition supplies the counterfeit-presentation model.
Declaring or finding false supplies the eventual verdict on the presentation.
Recognition through an effect or sign supplies the act that penetrates presentation.
A visible mark that makes its bearer known supplies embodied evidence.
Seizure and capture supply the consequence once the mark is read.

structural_cues: 55:41 compresses recognition, marks, and bodily seizure into one causal-looking sequence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies recognition by marks followed by capture; I infer that signs expose a previously maintained false presentation. A live alternative is that the marks merely identify already manifest offenders without an exposure phase.

changed_reading.before: Denial is only a false utterance about favor.
changed_reading.after: Denial can be a counterfeit way of appearing in the world, eventually contradicted by the marks one's conduct has made visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus dual grammar joins a context of two weight-bearing collectives, paired fruits, and act-for-act return; the two addressees are not parallel spectators but reciprocal witnesses inside a paired moral order.

activation_trace.role: A right or liability that follows its bearer supplies an accountable claim carried by favor.
Fulfillment or failure of a charge makes the dual answer jointly consequential.
Precious weight supplies the two collectives with moral heft rather than numerical duality alone.
A counterpart joined to its mate supplies the context's pairing logic.
Recompense answering action supplies reciprocity within the paired order.
Good action repeated on both sides supplies the quality of the reciprocal answer.

structural_cues: The focus has dual possession and dual predication; 55:31 names a dual collective, while the garden sequence repeatedly presents twos and pairs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies grammatically dual address, weight-bearing collectives, counterparts, and reciprocal action; I infer mutual witness and answerability between the two parties. A live alternative is that duality only identifies two species independently addressed.

changed_reading.before: Two groups happen to receive the same repeated question.
changed_reading.after: The two groups are made a witnessing pair: each answer to favor is exposed beside the other's and participates in a reciprocal order.

context_deltas.mechanism: Placed between useful goodness and visually marked, sheltered companions, the focus question tests whether beauty is recognized as beneficent relation or flattened into consumable appearance.

activation_trace.role: Deceptive variegated appearance supplies the risk of mistaking surface display for truth.
Proving true through fulfillment supplies a nonvisual criterion for the gift.
Inclination toward useful good supplies the ethical pole of the description.
Beauty opposed to ugliness supplies the aesthetic pole joined to goodness.
Marked ocular contrast supplies the strongly visual continuation after the refrain.
Restriction and keeping to a bounded place supply protected particularity.
Tent and dwelling supply situated relation rather than free-floating display.

structural_cues: 55:71 is exactly the hinge between the compact moral-aesthetic description in 55:70 and the visual, bounded dwelling description in 55:72.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies useful good, beauty, visual contrast, confinement, and dwelling; I infer that the refrain interrogates how these qualities are perceived, not merely whether the objects exist. A live alternative is an uninterrupted catalog of delights with no critique of surface perception.

changed_reading.before: The refrain simply confirms another attractive item in the garden inventory.
changed_reading.after: The refrain asks whether the addressees can recognize beauty as useful, protected goodness rather than falsify it into mere surface availability.

context_deltas.mechanism: The closing named blessing activates lasting and increasing branches in the focus lord-title: each enumerated favor is a local manifestation of goodness that stays, grows, and returns to the named source.

activation_trace.role: Bestowal supplies the local instances gathered by the closing movement.
Staying and lasting supply continuity beneath the changing inventory.
Increase and rising supply a non-dominant growth undertone to lordly care.
The name as designation gathers dispersed acts under a recognizable source.
Stable, growing good supplies the closing transformation of listed gifts into generative blessing.

structural_cues: The final verse repeats the focus lord-title and closes the whole sequence by predicating blessing of the name.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies designation, stable growing good, and a repeated lord-title; I infer that the close retrospectively gathers the refrains into one generative source. A live alternative is that the final blessing is only a doxological seal.

changed_reading.before: Each refrain audits one finished item in a list.
changed_reading.after: Each refrain encounters one outgrowth of a goodness that remains generative and is finally gathered under the giver's name.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The plant-name branch is lexically remote and must not replace the ordinary favor sense; it remains anchored in the focus word-2 root and is activated by the surrounding fruit, palm, pomegranate, and beauty sequence. Downstream prose should render it only as a botanical sensory echo: a gift may be beautiful to sight yet carry a bitter demand.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-2 root's named-shrub branch, held under the focus question about favor.

activation_trace.role: A visually fine but bitter-tasting shrub supplies the contained sensory reversal.
Pleasant fruit supplies the dominant sweet botanical field against which bitterness registers.
The palm supplies a named plant immediately preceding the focus hinge.
Pomegranate extends the concrete botanical inventory around the focus.
Beauty supplies the visual attractiveness half of the shrub branch's tension.

changed_reading.before: Every favor in this garden register is uncomplicated sweetness.
changed_reading.after: As a contained echo, the favor-question can preserve a beautiful/bitter tension: attraction does not cancel the demand to answer.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The milk-failure idiom is branch-distant, but it remains directly anchored in the focus denial root and is materially activated by continuing gift-flow, running springs, and gushing water. Downstream prose should frame it as an analogy for mistrusting provision, not as a lexical translation of the focus verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-4 denial root's branch for a supply disappearing or failing expected duration.

activation_trace.role: Milk that fails expected duration supplies the fear that provision will not continue.
Continuing sustenance and giving supply the counter-image of dependable flow.
A spring as the source of running water materializes provision at its origin.
Water welling abundantly supplies the explicit reversal of expected failure.

changed_reading.before: To deny favor is to dispute that it was given.
changed_reading.after: To deny can be to live as though the giver's provision will dry up, even while its sources are depicted as running and gushing.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The running-animal idiom is highly form-distant, but the focus denial root anchors it and the refrain's repeated placement after completed scenes visibly enacts a halt and retrospective look. Downstream prose should call this a formal analogy in the refrain's pacing, never a replacement meaning for the verb.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-4 denial root's run-then-stop branch joined to word 2's following-voice split mapping.

activation_trace.role: Running a stage and stopping to look behind supplies the refrain's retrospective pause.
A second voice following the first supplies the answering sound at each pause.
The immediately prior occurrence confirms the same halt after an earlier garden scene.
The immediately following occurrence confirms serial following rather than an isolated pause.
A later repetition again supplies the stop-and-review cadence.

changed_reading.before: The refrain interrupts the descriptions by repetition.
changed_reading.after: The refrain may function as a deliberate stop-and-look-back checkpoint after each run of description, forcing retrospective judgment before movement resumes.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: The oath, liability, and pact branches form an unusual cross-mapping cluster and cannot establish a hidden legal translation; they remain anchored in all three focus roots and gain contextual traction from act-for-act recompense. Downstream prose should present a covenantal undertone in which favor carries a claim, not a settled juridical reading.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The word-2 oath and following-liability branches, word-3 pact branch, and word-4 fulfillment branch.

activation_trace.role: Oath-making supplies a solemn commitment undertone to receiving favor.
A right or liability following its bearer supplies the claim that travels with the gift.
Covenant and protection agreement supply the relational bond under lordship.
A charge proving true or false by completion supplies covenantal performance.
Recompense answering an act supplies contextual traction for a claim of response.

changed_reading.before: A favor is freely received and then cognitively acknowledged.
changed_reading.after: A favor may carry a covenant-like claim that follows its recipient and proves true or false in the recipient's answering act.

strongest_changes: The refrain became a test of performed return under just measure, not only a test of verbal assent.
The early mercy-teaching-creation sequence made the favors include the very faculties by which the addressees can answer.
The sea sequence made maintained boundaries and productive relations count as favors alongside objects.
The dual grammar became reciprocal witness between two weight-bearing collectives rather than incidental number.
Perishing, abiding, and recurrent action recast favors as successive traces of an enduring source.
summary.what_was_special: The focus is a repeated formula, so its latent force emerged less from a new referent than from branch interactions with sequence, measure, duality, material flow, and the exact hinge around 55:71. Non-dominant mappings remained especially productive: following voice, remainder, liability, capacity, and performed truth yielded several coexisting readings without replacing the ordinary favor-denial sense.
remaining_uncertainties: The non-dominant mappings for the word-2 and word-3 roots may describe rhetorical resonance rather than live lexical contribution.
The moral-aesthetic hinge can be read as a real perceptual test or as simple continuation of the garden catalog.
The covenantal, botanical, supply-failure, and stop-and-look-back readings require explicit exploratory qualification.
The inferred arrows from gift to obligation and from maintained boundary to productive emergence are coherent but reader-supplied.
